description: This file defines classes and structures for implementing task strands with various locking and prioritization policies, including single and multiple priority levels, for task execution management in a concurrent environment.

classes.name: priority_strand_queue
classes.description: Manages multiple priority queues for tasks, supporting try push and blocking pop operations.

classes.name: strand_queue
classes.description: Manages a single queue for tasks with non-blocking try push and blocking pop operations.

classes.name: basic_strand_lock
classes.description: Implements a simple lock mechanism to ensure sequential task processing in a strand.

classes.name: force_dispatch_strand_lock
classes.description: Implements a strand lock with forced dispatch capabilities and priority-based locking.

classes.name: task_strand_impl
classes.description: Template class implementing the core logic of a task strand with locking policies.

classes.name: task_strand
classes.description: Implements a task strand with optional prioritization and batching, dispatching tasks to an executor.

classes.name: task_strand_executor
classes.description: Executor wrapper for a task strand, enabling execution and deferral of tasks.

classes.name: priority_task_strand_executor
classes.description: Executor for dispatching tasks with specific priority levels to a strand.

classes.name: priority_task_strand
classes.description: Implements a task strand supporting multiple priority levels, managing multiple executors.

methods.name: on_new_task
methods.description: Registers a new task in the strand, updating task count and lock state.

methods.name: get_queue_size
methods.description: Returns the current number of pending tasks in the strand.

methods.name: on_task_completion
methods.description: Updates task count after tasks are completed and manages unlocking.

methods.name: handle_enqueued_task
methods.description: Determines if the strand should dispatch tasks based on current state.

methods.name: run_enqueued_tasks
methods.description: Executes all enqueued tasks in the strand, respecting batch size.

methods.name: dispatch_value_dequeue_task
methods.description: Dispatches a task to dequeue multiple tasks in batch.

methods.name: handle_failed_task_dispatch
methods.description: Handles failure to dispatch tasks by discarding remaining queued tasks.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Enqueues a task and attempts to handle its execution in the strand.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Enqueues a task for deferred execution.

methods.name: get_executor
methods.description: Returns a reference to the executor managing the strand.
